title: Brick Schema
description: Uniform metadata schema for buildings: a vocabulary for describing the points (sensors, setpoints, commands, statuses, alarms), equipment (AHUs, chillers, pumps, VAVs, network devices, etc.), and their relationships (hasPoint/isPointOf, hasPart/isPartOf, feeds/isFedBy, hasUnit via QUDT) in building automation and IoT deployments. Widely used in the building controls / smart buildings community.
publisher: Brick Consortium (UC Berkeley, with industry and academic contributors); ontology hosted at ontology.brickschema.org

models.name: Equipment
models.title: Smart Data Models - Brick Schema - Equipment
models.description: A physical piece of equipment in a building's mechanical, electrical or IT systems: an air handling unit, chiller, pump, VAV box, thermostat, network device, etc. (brick:Equipment and its subclasses, Brick Schema). Modeled generically -- see the brickClass property -- rather than as hundreds of separate entity types.

models.name: Point
models.title: Smart Data Models - Brick Schema - Point
models.description: A telemetry point exposed by a piece of building Equipment or associated with a Location: a sensor, setpoint, command, status, alarm or parameter (brick:Point and its subclasses, Brick Schema). This candidate models Point generically -- see the brickClass property -- rather than as hundreds of separate entity types.

title: EDINT Infrastructure Ontology (Ontología de Infraestructura)
description: Vocabulary for representing a municipality's public and private infrastructure facilities (educational, cultural, social, sports and health centers, on-street and off-street parking, shared-bicycle stations) together with the sensors, observations, violations, management roles and organizations involved in operating and monitoring them. Reuses SOSA/SSN (sensors and observations), GeoSPARQL (geometry), schema.org and Dublin Core.
publisher: EDINT - Espacio de Datos para las Infraestructuras Urbanas Inteligentes (EU-funded), with Universidad Politécnica de Madrid (UPM) as technical developer

models.name: AccessObservation
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - AccessObservation
models.description: Observation carried out at any entrance to a municipal facility. This includes pedestrian or vehicle access (edintinf:AccessObservation, subclass of sosa:Observation).

models.name: AccessSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - AccessSensor
models.description: A device that records the access of people or vehicles. This could be an LPR (license plate recognition) camera, a building entrance door sensor, or other similar devices (edintinf:AccessSensor, subclass of sosa:Sensor).

models.name: BikeSharingStation
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - BikeSharingStation
models.description: A Facility specialization for shared-bicycle stations (edintinf:EstacionBicicleta). Like Parking, the source ontology defines no attributes of its own beyond those inherited from Facility. Check for overlap with any existing bike-sharing SDM model before promoting this candidate.

models.name: CountingObservation
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - CountingObservation
models.description: Observation on the number of people or vehicles that a sensor counts (edintinf:CountingObservation, subclass of sosa:Observation).

models.name: CountingSensor
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - CountingSensor
models.description: A device that records the number of people or vehicles that it observes (edintinf:CountingSensor, subclass of sosa:Sensor).

models.name: Facility
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - Facility
models.description: It refers to service buildings (public or private), leisure areas, commercial areas or any other element that directly affects mobility, acting as a focus of attraction for persons or vehicles. Source: EDINT Infrastructure Ontology (edintinf:Facility).

models.name: ManagementRole
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - ManagementRole
models.description: The role that the municipal administration or one of its departments plays in the management of a municipal facility. This may include ownership, maintenance, security, among others (edintinf:ManagementRole).

models.name: ObservationPoint
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - ObservationPoint
models.description: Points where access or counting observations can be made using sensors (edintinf:ObservationPoint). The source ontology defines no attributes of its own beyond location; it is the target of the Facility.hasObservationPoint relationship.

models.name: Organization
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - Organization
models.description: Any public or private organization that owns or manages an element of the infrastructure (edintinf:Organization). NOTE: check for overlap with the existing official Smart Data Models 'dataModel.Organization' subject before promoting this candidate.

models.name: Parking
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - Parking
models.description: A Facility specialization for on-street and off-street parking areas. The source ontology (edintinf:Parking) defines no attributes beyond those inherited from Facility; it is distinguished only by its NGSI-LD type and, typically, its infrastructureType value. NOTE: this concept is likely to overlap with the already-existing official Smart Data Models 'dataModel.Parking' subject (e.g. OffStreetParking/OnStreetParking) — check for duplication before promoting this candidate.

models.name: Violation
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - Violation
models.description: Non-compliance or violation of traffic or access rules, road laws or local ordinances by a person or a driver or owner of a vehicle (edintinf:Violation).

title: SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology, as demonstrated by the EDINT Tourism repository
description: Vocabulary for representing tourism accommodation establishments (hotels, guest houses, aparthotels) and historical/cultural resources (fortified palaces, amphitheatres, aqueducts, and 40+ related types), together with their location, contact points, booking channels, ratings and descriptions. Drawn from SEGITTUR's Core Tourism Ontology (estur:), a large (388-class) reference model for a Network of Tourism Sector Ontologies serving Spain's future Intelligent Destination Platform (PID).
publisher: SEGITTUR (Sociedad Estatal para la Gestión de la Innovación y las Tecnologías Turísticas), with the Ontology Engineering Group (Universidad Politécnica de Madrid), Globaldit and Gnoss as technical developers

models.name: Alcazar
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Alcazar
models.description: Alcazar (fortified palace), a specialization of HistoricalOrCulturalResource (estur:HistoricalOrCulturalResource, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology) — one of 43 such subclasses in the full ontology (others include Museum, Castle, Cathedral, Monastery, etc.), of which this candidate only covers the three demonstrated with real example data. NOTE: the source repository's example data uses the misspellings 'Amphiteatre' and 'Acueduct'; the authoritative ontology spells these 'Amphitheatre' and 'Aqueduct', which are used here.

models.name: Amphitheatre
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Amphitheatre
models.description: Amphitheatre, a specialization of HistoricalOrCulturalResource (estur:HistoricalOrCulturalResource, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology) — one of 43 such subclasses in the full ontology (others include Museum, Castle, Cathedral, Monastery, etc.), of which this candidate only covers the three demonstrated with real example data. NOTE: the source repository's example data uses the misspellings 'Amphiteatre' and 'Acueduct'; the authoritative ontology spells these 'Amphitheatre' and 'Aqueduct', which are used here.

models.name: Aparthotel
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Aparthotel
models.description: Aparthotel, a specialization of AccommodationEstablishment (estur:AccommodationEstablishment via TourismOrRelatedFacility, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology). NOTE: the source repository's README uses the misspelling 'AccomodationEstablishment' (single 'm'); the authoritative ontology spells it 'AccommodationEstablishment' (double 'm'), which is used throughout this candidate.

models.name: Aqueduct
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Aqueduct
models.description: Aqueduct, a specialization of HistoricalOrCulturalResource (estur:HistoricalOrCulturalResource, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology) — one of 43 such subclasses in the full ontology (others include Museum, Castle, Cathedral, Monastery, etc.), of which this candidate only covers the three demonstrated with real example data. NOTE: the source repository's example data uses the misspellings 'Amphiteatre' and 'Acueduct'; the authoritative ontology spells these 'Amphitheatre' and 'Aqueduct', which are used here.

models.name: BookingChannel
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - BookingChannel
models.description: A channel through which a tourism resource, service or organisation can be booked (estur:BookingChannel, a ContactPoint subclass, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology).

models.name: ContactPoint
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - ContactPoint
models.description: A means of contacting a tourism entity or organisation (estur:ContactPoint, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology).

models.name: Description
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Description
models.description: A textual description of a tourism entity (estur:Description, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology).

models.name: Hostal
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Hostal
models.description: Hostal (Spanish guest house), a specialization of AccommodationEstablishment (estur:AccommodationEstablishment via TourismOrRelatedFacility, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology). NOTE: the source repository's README uses the misspelling 'AccomodationEstablishment' (single 'm'); the authoritative ontology spells it 'AccommodationEstablishment' (double 'm'), which is used throughout this candidate.

models.name: Hotel
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Hotel
models.description: Hotel, a specialization of AccommodationEstablishment (estur:AccommodationEstablishment via TourismOrRelatedFacility, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology). NOTE: the source repository's README uses the misspelling 'AccomodationEstablishment' (single 'm'); the authoritative ontology spells it 'AccommodationEstablishment' (double 'm'), which is used throughout this candidate.

models.name: Location
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Location
models.description: The location of a tourism entity (accommodation, historical/cultural resource, etc.), modeled as a standalone, referenceable resource, matching the source ontology's own design (estur:Location, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology).

models.name: Rating
models.title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Rating
models.description: A rating of a tourism resource, service or organisation (estur:Rating, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology). NOTE: the source ontology's own SHACL shapes define a different, incompatible field set for Rating (bookingValue/googleReviewValue/tripAdvisorValue as floats, plus a flat 'stars' integer directly on Hotel) that does not match either the OWL property definitions or any real example data found. This candidate follows ratingUnit/ratingValue because that is what the real, published open-data examples (and the OWL definitions) actually use — check with SEGITTUR before assuming either naming scheme is final.

title: Accidentes de Tráfico de la Ciudad de Madrid (Traffic Accidents in the City of Madrid)
description: Traffic accidents in the City of Madrid with victims and/or municipal property damage, registered by Policía Municipal. Sourced from a PDF field specification (in Spanish) rather than a formal ontology -- this candidate was built directly from that specification and cross-checked against the real, published CSV dataset for the year 2023.
publisher: Dirección General de la Policía Municipal, Ayuntamiento de Madrid
license: Not stated in the source PDF specification. The Madrid open data portal's general terms of use should be checked before promoting this candidate; not verified as part of this translation.

models.name: AccidentInvolvedPerson
models.title: Smart Data Models - Madrid Traffic Accidents - AccidentInvolvedPerson
models.description: A record of one person involved in a traffic accident in the City of Madrid, as registered by the Policia Municipal (drivers, passengers, pedestrians, witnesses). The source dataset publishes one row per involved person, not per accident -- accident-level fields (location, weather, type, coordinates) are repeated identically across every person in the same accident, which this candidate's entity design mirrors faithfully. Source: 'Accidentes de Trafico de la Ciudad de Madrid', Direccion General de la Policia Municipal, version November 2023.
